name: fred
caption:
UNDRAFTED 🎮🏀 Nobody picked Fred VanVleet. We signed him anyway.

• 2016: undrafted, signs with us
• 2019 playoffs: ice cold, 6-for-42 over 9 games
• May 20: Fred Jr. is born in the middle of the East finals, and Fred catches fire
• Finals Game 6: 22 points, 5 threes off the bench, we win the title
• 2022: All-Star

Best underdog story in our history? 👇

beats.head: UNDRAFTED
beats.name: FRED
beats.vo: Twenty sixteen. The draft comes and goes, and nobody picks Fred VanVleet. We sign him anyway.

beats.head: ICE COLD
beats.name: FRED
beats.vo: Twenty nineteen playoffs. Fred is ice cold. Six for forty-two over nine games.

beats.head: FRED JR.
beats.name: FRED
beats.vo: Then, on May twentieth, his son is born, right in the middle of the East finals. And Fred catches fire.
beats.dlg: MAY 20: FRED JR. IS BORN...|AND FRED CATCHES FIRE!

beats.head: FINALS GAME 6
beats.vo: Finals Game six. Twenty-two points, five threes, off the bench. We win the title.

beats.head: ALL-STAR
beats.name: FRED
beats.vo: Twenty twenty-two: an All-Star. Not bad for a guy nobody drafted.

beats.head: STEADY FRED
beats.vo: Best underdog story in our history? Comment below.

facts.claim: VanVleet went undrafted in 2016 and signed with Toronto; shot 6-42 (3-24 from three) over 9 playoff games before his son was born May 20, 2019 during the East finals; 22 points with 5 threes off the bench in Finals Game 6; All-Star 2022; wore #23 in Toronto
